read_only_method: HTTP POST application/x-www-form-urlencoded containing SELECT only; no update/query mutation

independent_oracle_method.candidate_discovery: all named-graph subjects with the exact asserted path predicate/object; full outgoing candidate membership quads are independently audited across all named graphs, without rdf:type, term, date, reverse-link, or owner filters
independent_oracle_method.K_path: members:isRepresentativeFrom exact Kildare North resource; qualify against that target's independently observed unique current HouseTerm, explicit DailMembership, Member reverse link, same owner graph/memberCode, and explicit active membership DateRange at asOf
independent_oracle_method.R_path: members:isCommitteeMembershipOf exact Committee resource; qualify explicit CommitteeMembership, Member reverse link, same owner graph/memberCode, and explicit active membership DateRange at asOf; no term equality or party filter
independent_oracle_method.intersection: exact Member IRI set intersection of independently qualifying K and R witnesses
independent_oracle_method.date_policy: Inclusive date-grain containment using each source xsd:dateTime calendar date against 2026-11-11; absent EndDate is open-ended; missing/malformed/multiple StartDate or EndDate, missing range type, and absent range are not positive witnesses
independent_oracle_method.simple_string_datatypes: RDF 1.1 simple literals without xml:lang are treated as xsd:string where the authoritative property range is xsd:string; raw SPARQL JSON datatype omission is retained
independent_oracle_method.member_owner_graph: Member graph derived from the single xsd:string/RDF 1.1 simple-literal agents:memberCode using UTF-8 percent-encoding in the graph URI path, then checked against the observed graph name
independent_oracle_method.data_scope: Only exact target resources, matching exact membership paths, reverse-linked Member owner graphs, their membership ranges, and relevant current-term/provenance graph checks; not a full-store snapshot or completeness claim

query_limits.pagination: ORDER BY all projected RDF terms, LIMIT up to 100 OFFSET 0,100,... until final page has fewer rows than its request limit; a diagnostic-bound stop remains incomplete

post_kernel_stability_instructions.behavior: Repeats the same exact-scoped read-only SELECT set and writes a new timestamped file; never overwrites oracle.json. Run only after the kernel run has completed.
post_kernel_stability_instructions.comparison_scope: Compare candidate path rows, target/term identity facts, Member owner/code/type/reverse links, and interval quads only. This is scoped evidence stability, not a transactional snapshot or full-store delta.

limitations: The captures are sequential requests, not a transactional dataset snapshot.
No claim is made that local Fuseki contains the complete Oireachtas source corpus.
As-of date-grain semantics are explicit in this independent oracle and are not asserted to reconstruct kernel behavior.
No cross-path equality between constituency-member HouseTerm and Committee HouseTerm is applied.
No party collection or affiliation evidence is queried or used.
